mechanism_narrative: Continued declines in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicate fewer downtown trips and less daytime spending capacity, which should push RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks as commuting-linked retail demand keeps eroding.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not stay below its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days despite TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remaining at or below current levels.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL remains elevated above 25 points while PARKS and TRANSIT stay deeply negative, households substitute toward home-based activity and avoid discretionary shopping, causing RETAIL_REC to fall further within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays above 25 and TRANSIT stays below -75
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days even though RESIDENTIAL remains above 25 and TRANSIT remains below -75.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rebound in GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS while TRANSIT is still very weak signals localized neighborhood activity that can spill into nearby discretionary purchases, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or falls over the next 28 days while both GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS improve relative to current levels.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT falls below -80 and WORKPLACES stays below -70, the city is in a severe-disruption regime where shopping trips are delayed rather than redistributed, so RETAIL_REC should continue to decline over the next week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -80 and WORKPLACES stays below -70
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC improves within 7 days after TRANSIT crosses below -80 while WORKPLACES remains below -70.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in RESIDENTIAL together with further weakness in RETAIL_REC itself captures substitution into home delivery and in-home consumption, which should keep store visits below the recent average over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC exceeds its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL continues to rise.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS activity stabilizes or rises from its current deep trough, warmer-weather discretionary outings should spill into retail corridors and raise RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS stops falling and moves above -65
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days after PARKS moves above -65.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, a deepening drop in WORKPLACES is a leading indicator of weaker consumer circulation, so RETAIL_REC should keep falling over the next four weeks even if grocery trips remain less depressed.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES continues to decline from current levels.

mechanism_narrative: A further week-on-week decline in TRANSIT combined with no recovery in GROCERY_PHARM marks shrinking multi-purpose trip chains, which should push RETAIL_REC lower within one week as incidental shopping disappears.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT declines for another week and GROCERY_PHARM stays below -45
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 7 days after TRANSIT weakens further and GROCERY_PHARM remains below -45.
